candidates.title: A PAL Airlines flight lost a wheel less than 2 weeks ago. It's happened again — to the same plane
candidates.description: Less than two weeks after a PAL Airlines flight lost a wheel, the airline has confirmed the same plane lost another one Thursday. Flight 411 was bound for Deer Lake, Newfoundland and Labrador, but instead landed in St. John's.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Mice, pigeon infestations at Halifax-area hospitals lead to soaring pest-control costs
candidates.description: CBC News has learned that several Halifax-area hospitals have been dealing with soaring costs to deal with mice and pigeon infestations. Nova Scotia Health says it could take years to rid its facilities of the mice issue.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Montreal tenants without hot water, electricity during heated dispute over renovations
candidates.description: A group of private investors bought the units in 2024 under the banner Norgate Québec Inc. The Comité logement Saint-Laurent says many of the units are occupied by immigrants and recent newcomers to Quebec.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Report of children confined in locker at Quebec school draws minister's condemnation
candidates.description: Students at a primary school were allegedly placed in a metal locker as a disciplinary measure. The Education Ministry is in touch with the investigating authorities to better understand what took place.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canada has the opportunity to become a global LNG leader, new report says
candidates.description: Canada’s only liquified natural gas facility began operating last year, yet the country has an opportunity to scale up that industry and become one of the top natural gas exporters in the world, according to a new report.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Severe stomach bug hits Montreal’s homeless population, shelter workers raise alarm
candidates.description: A severe stomach bug has spread through Montreal's homeless population, raising concern among shelter workers who say not enough is being done to contain it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Pilot killed in plane crash during Remembrance Day event in Quebec's Beauce region
candidates.description: More details are emerging about the plane crash that killed a 68-year-old pilot during a Remembrance Day ceremony Wednesday morning in Saint-Georges-de-Beauce, Que.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Heritage Minute filmed in Wainwright honours fallen Canadian soldier
candidates.description: Capt. Jon Snyder received a Star of Military Valour for his leadership and bravery when his team was attacked in Afghanistan in 2008. The Heritage Minute was filmed at CFB Wainwright and the surrounding area over the summer.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Border control pilot launched to stem drug smuggling into 5 First Nations in northern Ontario
candidates.description: A new border control pilot program aims to prevent drug and alcohol smuggling into five First Nation communities in northern Ontario, with some pointing to the Toronto area as a source of drugs entering the communities. The program, led by the largest Indigenous police force in Canada, was launched as Nishnawbe Aski Nation is in a state of emergency over drug trafficking and related violence.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canadian government says Russian players with visas will still be barred from WJC
candidates.description: The federal government says Russian hockey players will not be permitted to compete at next month's world junior championship in Alberta, even if they already hold valid Canadian visas.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Series of storms leaves B.C. woman with tree stuck on her house for days
candidates.description: A B.C. woman who saw a tree fall onto her house last Friday says it'll have to remain in place as high winds continue to batter the province.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Various beers under Molson Coors banner recalled Canada-wide
candidates.description: Various beers, both alcoholic and non-alcoholic, under the Molson Coors banner have been recalled across Canada due to pieces of metal, according to Health Canada.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ottawa had been aware of Stellantis-Roshel talks for months, source says
candidates.description: The federal government had been made aware for months about the possibility that Stellantis would sell its Brampton, Ont., assembly plant to a light armoured vehicle manufacturer, a source has told CBC News.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Halifax’s Brian Ahern, who produced albums by Anne Murray and Johnny Cash, dead at 81
candidates.description: A Halifax-born music producer who played a big role in helping encourage fellow Bluenoser Anne Murray to pursue a career in music and later produced albums by artists such as Johnny Cash and Emmylou Harris is being remembered for the mark he left on the music industry.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Jays' Anthony Santander stays quiet after team asks him to publicly address anti-Muslim social media posts
candidates.description: The Toronto Blue Jays have asked Anthony Santander to publicly address the controversy sparked by his decision to share anti-Muslim posts on social media. So far, the veteran outfielder has remained quiet and hasn't issued an apology.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Quebec government to table bill restricting access to English-language colleges
candidates.description: Next year will mark half a century since the adoption of Quebec's Charter of the French Language, and the Parti Québécois government intends to mark the milestone by reforming the law, says Pascal Bérubé, the minister of the French language.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: B.C. search-and-rescue mule using his nose to help solve Arizona cold case
candidates.description: A British Columbia mule with a nose that knows is helping investigators trying to crack a missing persons cold case in Arizona.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Deadline nears to claim piece of $11-million CIBC mutual funds settlement
candidates.description: Investors who held units of a CIBC mutual fund or a Renaissance mutual fund on or before Sept. 5, 2025 might be eligible for compensation. The deadline to apply is Nov. 18.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Sleeping driver in self-driving vehicle woken up, stopped and charged in Ottawa
candidates.description: Provincial police in Ottawa said they stopped and charged a driver who was asleep in her self-driving Tesla during Tuesday rush hour on Highway 417.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Hegseth awards medal to Arlington soldier who scolded his group on decorum
candidates.description: U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth has given a top award to the service member who scolded him and his staff at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier following a Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: American Airlines resumes flights to Haiti, providing a vital route into the country
candidates.description: The U.S. airline has begun flying into northern Haiti on a daily basis, providing a vital route into the country at a time when Americans have few options to get there as the U.S. government advises people to avoid all travel to the Caribbean nation due to security concerns.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Will U.S. travel pick up after midterm 'blue wave'? Not so fast, say these Canadians
candidates.description: Travel from Canada to the U.S. dropped amid President Donald Trump's threats and trade war. While many Canadians view the Democratic Party's midterm election victory as an 'encouraging' sign, they say it's too soon to visit the U.S. again amid continued distrust.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Russian federation head Tretiak says it will seek compensation if barred from world juniors in Alberta
candidates.description: Russian hockey federation president Vladislav Tretiak is threatening to seek compensation from Canada and push for the relocation or cancellation of next month's world junior championship in Alberta if Russia is barred from competing.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Death toll climbs to 8 in Brooklyn building collapse
candidates.description: Eight people have died after a three-storey building in Brooklyn collapsed at the edge of a construction site, New York City's mayor said Thursday, as firefighters kept digging through the rubble to find others who may be trapped beneath the wreckage.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital kills 6 people, including surgeon, health authorities say
candidates.description: An Israeli airstrike on southern Gaza's main hospital overnight killed at least six Palestinians, including a surgeon and a teenage boy, medics said, the latest Israeli attack to undermine a year-old ceasefire in the war-shattered territory.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Carney wraps meetings on security, trade with European leaders in Ireland
candidates.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney heard from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Thursday about the state of negotiations with Russia as the two discussed continental security with European leaders.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. envoys head to Dublin to talk to Zelenskyy, after prior sitdown with Putin
candidates.description: U.S. envoys met Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin before heading to Ireland for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as Washington sought new momentum for its peace efforts.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns after academic credentials questioned
candidates.description: The Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court ruled last month that the documents Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted regarding his overseas education didn't meet election requirements.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Hegseth, wife and aides spark scolding from guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
candidates.description: A soldier guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery issued a verbal reprimand to a group of advisers and staffers with U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth following a Veterans Day ceremony.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canada says Russian hockey players with visas will still be barred from world junior championship
candidates.description: The federal government says Russian hockey players will not be permitted to compete at next month's world junior championship in Alberta, even if they already hold valid Canadian visas.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Mississippi's Scott Colom secures Senate seat in another midterm win for Democrats
candidates.description: Mississippi Democrat Scott Colom will be the state's first Black senator since the post-Civil War Reconstruction era. Colom's victory also offers Democrats an unexpected boost in their effort to win control of the U.S. Senate.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Millions of workers strike across Spain as citizens protest soaring housing costs
candidates.description: Millions of Spanish workers shut down businesses and public transportation across the eurozone's fourth largest economy on Wednesday before thousands took to the streets of major cities in a nationwide protest over soaring rents and real estate prices.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Jim Jordan, once called a 'legislative terrorist' by a top Republican, will now lead the party in U.S. House
candidates.description: The Republicans may have just lost control of the House of Representatives in resounding fashion, but they signalled Tuesday they may not be in a conciliatory mood with Democrats, picking combative Ohio Rep. Jim Jordan as their leader in the chamber.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Martin Luther King Jr.'s handwritten draft of 'I Have a Dream' speech found in desk drawer
candidates.description: The day Martin Luther King Jr. stood on the steps of the Lincoln Memorial and delivered his iconic "I Have A Dream" speech is forever etched in the annals of history. But the night before — when the U.S. civil rights leader stayed up alone in his hotel room scribbling his now-famous words on a yellow notepad — was a moment lost to time. Until now.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Camps destroyed in 2 Israeli military strikes on Gaza City
candidates.description: Video shows the moment an Israeli military strike struck near a displacement camp south of Gaza City on Nov. 10. It followed a warning call to a resident of the camp and a smaller drone strike.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Father of baby who was rescued after being buried alive is charged with attempted murder
candidates.description: A missing 11-month-old infant was rescued Tuesday after being buried alive in a dog crate in South Carolina. His father has been charged with attempted murder.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Stacy Keach, stage actor and Mike Hammer star, dead at 85
candidates.description: Stacy Keach, one of America's finest stage actors who became best known for playing scruffy private eye Mike Hammer on TV and whose career was nearly derailed after he was imprisoned in 1984 for trying to smuggle cocaine into Britain, died Tuesday. He was 85.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 3 dead, driver arrested after vehicle plows into pedestrians in Los Angeles
candidates.description: The 61-year-old driver of a minivan that killed three people when it crashed outside a Los Angeles metro station during rush hour was arrested on three counts of murder, a police spokesperson said Wednesday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Industry minister terminates resolution talks with Stellantis over Brampton auto plant sale
candidates.description: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly has written the CEO of Stellantis Canada saying the government is terminating a resolution process and notifying the automaker that it is in default of a 2022 funding agreement after the company announced its intentions to sell its Brampton, Ont., plant to an armoured vehicle manufacturer.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after affair raises national security concerns
candidates.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday after his extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy raised national security concerns. It comes after reporting late on Wednesday that he had another extramarital affair with an Nvidia employee who reports to him.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Anthropic IPO to test the first 'pure play' AI stock in a choppy market
candidates.description: American AI giant Anthropic's expected debut on the Nasdaq has one money manager recalling the dot-com bubble of the 2000s.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Carney aware of 'some aspects' of Stellantis auto plant sale, but says company still broke deal
candidates.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney says he had been informed of "some aspects" of Stellantis's plan to sell an idled Brampton, Ont., auto plant to Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc., before the deal was announced.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How China gets around the U.S. ban on Nvidia chips
candidates.description: The revelation that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with a former executive of a Singapore-based company has raised concerns about China's ability to acquire top-tier microchips restricted to the country.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: LinkedIn, Monster take down over 1,000 fake job postings after CBC investigation
candidates.description: More than 1,500 misleading job postings on LinkedIn and Monster were actually connected to a multi-level marketing company, a CBC News visual investigation has found.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Did Stellantis violate its deals with the feds? Funding contract provided exceptions around Brampton
candidates.description: On Tuesday, Prime Minister Mark Carney called Stellantis' now-confirmed plans to sell an automotive assembly plant in Brampton, Ont., "a betrayal" of the global automaker's "obligations to Canada and by extension to all Canadians."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: TV providers say Rogers' Monday hockey move inflates prices, 'erodes' sports viewing
candidates.description: A trio of television providers are accusing Rogers Communications Inc. of violating competition rules and inflating Canadian sports fans' bills by moving Monday night hockey broadcasts exclusively to its Sportsnet Plus streaming service for this NHL season.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Vancouver-based meal kit company Fresh Prep approved to purchase competitor Goodfood
candidates.description: Fresh Prep refused to disclose how much it will pay for Goodfood but says the deal is expected to close on or around Friday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: US envoys meet Zelensky in Dublin after talks with Putin in Moscow
candidates.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
candidates.description: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
candidates.description: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
candidates.description: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
candidates.description: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
candidates.description: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
candidates.description: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
candidates.description: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Search for British woman missing from Tui cruise in Atlantic called off
candidates.description: The 72-year-old is believed to have gone overboard from the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
candidates.description: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
candidates.description: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Famed ship SS United States deliberately sunk off Florida coast to become a reef
candidates.description: Activists wanted the historic liner to be turned into a museum, but it will instead become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
candidates.description: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
candidates.description: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Missing 11-month-old baby rescued after being buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
candidates.description: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
candidates.description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
candidates.description: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'We've got to run': Inside ruined Ukraine power plant under constant drone threat
candidates.description: Dan Johnson visits one of the country's largest power stations, barely left standing after a ballistic missile strike by Russia.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
candidates.description: Following a ceremony marking Veterans Day, a group that included Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth was shouted at to be quiet.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: Vinícius Jr's surprise message to boy who received prosthetic legs after Sudan drone strike
candidates.description: Real Madrid player Vinícius Jr sent a surprise message to 13-year-old fan Zaher who lost both his legs after being hit by a drone in Khartoum, in 2024.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Jensen Huang has resigned, what's next for Nvidia?
candidates.description: The BBC's Samira Hussain reports from Wall Street on what the fall of the tech superstar means for the company and AI.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
candidates.description: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: How AI visionary Jensen Huang was undone by his own bad decisions
candidates.description: Zoe Kleinman explains how the man who built Nvidia from the ground up lost everything in a matter of days.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently?
candidates.description: Chief financial officer Colette Kress in in charge of Nvidia for now, but several others are in the frame as potential successors.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Lego marketplace BrickLink offline after 'unusual activity' detected
candidates.description: Known as the eBay of Lego, it has been down for three days and is yet to disclose what caused the shutdown.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
candidates.description: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'Summer was a wake-up call, winter could be dire' warning over food supplies
candidates.description: Wales needs to grow more fruit and veg or it will be at the mercy of wars and climate change, one expert says.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Duchy tenants may have to buy farms or leave as Prince William plans sell-off
candidates.description: A ten-year strategy to raise £500m from the Duchy of Cornwall will see farms sold off across England.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in the Kremlin after Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
candidates.description: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff went to the Kremlin to brief Russian President Vladimir Putin and are scheduled to fly later to Ireland for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Indonesia's VP resigns as his eligibility and academic credentials are questioned
candidates.description: Raka is the son of former President Joko Widodo. The Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court ruled last month that the documents that Raka submitted regarding his overseas education didn't meet election requirements.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
candidates.description: After more than a week of counting ballots, Scott Colom has narrowly won the Mississippi Senate seat. And, the White House has sent a letter warning Democrats who plan to investigate the administration.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Former Ukrainian foreign minister discusses how to bridge gaps between Ukraine, Russia
candidates.description: NPR's A Martinez asks Ukraine's former Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba for his proposals to close gaps in talks between Russia, Ukraine and Europe.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Former U.S. Ambassador William Taylor discusses the latest Russia-Ukraine talks
candidates.description: NPR's A Martinez speaks with former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine, William Taylor, about the ongoing peace talks between the U.S., Russia and Ukraine.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: U.S. officials set to meet with Putin, Zelenskyy following Abu Dhabi peace talks
candidates.description: U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi have wrapped up with an agreement on a Russia-Ukraine prisoner exchange. U.S. negotiators meet with Vladimir Putin on Thursday and Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Friday.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Drought threatens Iraq's marshes, risking one of the oldest ways of life
candidates.description: The unique marshes of southern Iraq are beginning to revive after five years of devastating drought. But challenges remain for one of the world's oldest ways of life.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Aid groups call on Israel to allow shelters in Gaza amid a humanitarian emergency
candidates.description: Winter storms have brought flooding and deadly landslides to thousands living in tents in Gaza. Palestinians have no where to go after years of devasting war.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: An Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital kills 6 people, including a doctor and a child
candidates.description: The victims included a surgeon, and dozens more were injured. Israel said it was targeting a Hamas commander and other militants. The commander was not found among the dead.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers are competing in the Youth Olympics
candidates.description: Senegal's breakdancers have been practicing for their country's historic hosting of the Youth Olympic Games this month. It's the first time Africa is hosting an Olympic event.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: CEO Jensen Huang resigns from chip giant Nvidia
candidates.description: The chip giant Nvidia announced that CEO Jensen Huang was stepping down following allegations that he'd had extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

candidates.title: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years
candidates.description: Existing homes sales in October declined 8.8% from a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Jensen Huang biographer reacts to the Nvidia CEO's resignation
candidates.description: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Stephen Witt, author of a Jensen Huang biography, about his resignation from his role as CEO of Nvidia.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
candidates.description: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Why is gasoline suddenly under $4 a gallon?
candidates.description: The average price of a gallon of gasoline dipped below $4 this week for the first time in months. Does that mean more relief is coming for drivers?
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
candidates.description: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: The scandal surrounding the head of Nvidia could have wide-ranging implications
candidates.description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Bloomberg tech reporter Ian King about the unusually overarching role of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at his company and within the American tech industry at large.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Ebola tops 11,000 cases in Congo's deadliest outbreak
candidates.description: Congo's Ebola outbreak has topped 11,000 cases, the government said Wednesday, a stark figure that underscores the severity of the situation as the country grapples with the relentless spread of the disease.

candidates.title: Special Marine Warning issued November 12 at 5:02PM EST until November 12 at 6:00PM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
candidates.description: SMWPHI The National Weather Service in Mount Holly NJ has issued a * Special Marine Warning for... Coastal waters from Sandy Hook to Little Egg Inlet NJ out 20 nm... * Until 600 PM EST. * At 502 PM EST, severe thunderstorms were located along a line extending from 6 nm southwest of Fair Haven to 7 nm northwest of Point Pleasant Beach to 8 nm northwest of Silverton to 10 nm west of Pine Beach, moving east at 20 knots. HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and large hail. SOURCE...Radar. IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and suddenly higher waves. Large hail could result in structural damage. * Locations impacted include... Sea Girt Reef, Ocean Gate, Monmouth Beach, Sea Bright, Axel Carlson Reef, Silverton, Fair Haven, Lavallette, Shark River Reef, Point Pleasant Beach, Belmar, Seaside Park, Manasquan Inlet, Pine Beach, and Sandy Hook Reef.
candidates.author: National Weather Service

candidates.title: Flash Flood Warning issued November 12 at 5:01PM EST until November 12 at 6:15PM EST by NWS Upton NY
candidates.description: FFWOKX The National Weather Service in Upton has extended the * Flash Flood Warning for... Queens County in southeastern New York... * Until 615 PM EST. * At 501 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated showers with embedded thunderstorms approaching from the west. Additional moderate to heavy rainfall is expected over the next 1 to 2 hours. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 0.5 to 1 inch in 1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly. HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms. SOURCE...Radar indicated. IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor drainage and low-lying areas. * Some locations that will experience flash flooding include... Jamaica, Rockaway Beach and Kennedy Airport.

candidates.description: * WHAT...Dense fog. candidates.title: Flood Advisory issued November 12 at 4:57PM EST until November 12 at 8:00PM EST by NWS Upton NY
candidates.description: * WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected. * WHERE...Southern Essex County in northeastern New Jersey... Hudson County in northeastern New Jersey... Union County in northeastern New Jersey... * WHEN...Until 800 PM EST. * IMPACTS...Minor flooding, especially in low-lying and poor drainage areas. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 454 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This will cause urban and small stream flooding. Overflowing poor drainage areas will cause minor flooding in the advisory area. Between 0.5 and 1 inch of rain has fallen from previous rain earlier. - Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are expected over the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding. - Some locations that will experience flooding include... Newark, Jersey City, Elizabeth, Bayonne, Plainfield, Linden, Orange, Summit, Millburn, Secaucus, Harrison, Kearny, Clark, Union and East Orange. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
